title: Geometry Formulas: Area, Perimeter & Volume
description: The essential formulas for area, perimeter, surface area, and volume of common 2D and 3D shapes.
subject: math

cards.definition: A = πr², where r is the radius.
C = 2πr or C = πd, where r is the radius and d is the diameter.
V = πr²h, where r is the radius of the base and h is the height.
A = lw, where l is the length and w is the width.
P = 2l + 2w, where l is the length and w is the width.
A = s², where s is the side length.
P = 4s, where s is the side length.
A = (1/2)bh, where b is the base and h is the height measured perpendicular to the base.
P = a + b + c, where a, b, and c are the side lengths.
A = bh, where b is the base and h is the perpendicular height.
A = (1/2)(b₁ + b₂)h, where b₁ and b₂ are the parallel bases and h is the height.
A = (1/2)d₁d₂, where d₁ and d₂ are the lengths of the diagonals.
V = s³, where s is the edge length.
SA = 6s², where s is the edge length.
V = lwh, where l is the length, w is the width, and h is the height.

cards.term: Surface area of a rectangular prism
cards.definition: SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh, where l is the length, w is the width, and h is the height.
SA = 2πr² + 2πrh, where r is the radius and h is the height.
V = (1/3)πr²h, where r is the radius of the base and h is the height.
V = (1/3)Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height.
V = (4/3)πr³, where r is the radius.
SA = 4πr², where r is the radius.
